Hey Maya —

Congrats on the recent activity — our system flagged a usage spike from your org this morning (looks like several projects hit the 75% threshold). I wanted to offer a quick 15-minute ops walkthrough to show a couple of things that usually help teams in this stage:

- Where the token spend is concentrated (prefixes/routes)
- Low-lift batching / caching toggles that reduce per-token cost
- A short checklist for predictable latency at scale

Proposed 15-minute windows (all PT):
- Mon 9/20: 11:00am–11:15am PT
- Tue 9/21: 09:00am–09:15am PT
- Tue 9/21: 01:30pm–01:45pm PT

If those don't work, feel free to pick a time on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/15min

I’ve attached a one-pager that I’ll walk through (redwood-15min-onepager.pdf). Ben (cc’d) will join from solutions if we need to dig into a specific model or config.

Agenda is intentionally short — tradeoffs, quick wins, and next steps for a deeper technical review if you want.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Sales Development Representative
Redwood Inference
